result.rationale: The diff adds a token refresh in salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts that fetches a new access token and persists it via prisma.credential.update, but never assigns the new access_token back to credentialKey before `return new jsforce.Connection(...)`, so the connection is constructed with the stale credentialKey (the only in-memory token in scope). The refresh thus writes to DB but doesn't affect the current connection. The Connection's access_token argument isn't fully visible in the diff, so verification is partial, but the mechanism is consistent with the shown code.
